answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 746 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tide. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the onyx queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The haven index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 277 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
